description: Removes labels from every message in a thread, e.g. remove UNREAD to mark the whole conversation as read.

labelIds.description: Label ids: STARRED, UNREAD, INBOX, TRASH, SPAM, or a user label id from list_labels. Adding a folder label moves the message to that folder (one folder per message); removing the current folder label moves it back to INBOX.

name: unlabel_thread
